---
name: neoforge-implementation
description: Build or review a NeoForge feature that crosses lifecycle, registration, logical side, persistence, networking, data generation, configuration, or testing.
---

1. Read the active plan and verify the requested behavior is fully integrated.
2. Detect actual Minecraft, NeoForge, Java, Gradle, mappings, and dependency versions.
3. Map registration, state ownership, persistence, networking, permissions, client presentation, and generated data before editing.
4. Follow existing architecture and keep client classes out of dedicated server paths.
5. Validate every server mutation and network value.
6. Add focused unit tests, GameTests, and generated resources as required.
7. Run the repository verification matrix and update canonical documentation.
8. Leave linked work open when required checks fail.
